title: RustyCore Extractors Forever Rust-local DB2 manifest v4
description: Explicit Rust-local acquisition for the existing reviewed/default or pinned catalog selection policies. Reviewed unknown tables retain metadata-only claims; catalog results require full schema and row decoding. Acquisition does not establish runtime acceptance.

run_id.$comment: Optional: the local batch has no run-id source; a run that has one may include it.

install_fingerprint_sha256.$comment: Optional: omitted when the batch read no install-fingerprint source.

commit.$comment: Optional: the batch runtime embeds no git SHA; omitted rather than invented.

acquisition.title: Explicit Forever Rust local CASC acquisition profile v1
acquisition.$comment: Original contract 2026-10-11. Logical payload budgets are not RSS bounds. Current CLI selects one explicit layout uniformly for all sixteen index buckets. Parent component schema must further constrain file_bytes to its own ceiling. No source paths, keys, raw assets or network requests.

$comment: The offline Rust verifier additionally cross-checks acquisition.limits.file_bytes == options.max_file_bytes, artifact byte limits, option/format/artifact counts, table name/ID/path mapping, locale/build agreement, catalog provenance, and companion report acquisition. All references are local fragments; embedded acquisition and catalog identities are checked against their repository source schemas.
